p: A real polynomial whose classification is sought.
q: A real polynomial whose existence is required by the problem.
s: The real polynomial collecting the terms of order at least two in the exact expansion of r(x+r(x)).
f: The auxiliary real polynomial defined by f(x)=p(x)-x.
H: The real polynomial collecting all Taylor terms of order at least two after factoring out f(x)^2.
n: the degree of the nonconstant polynomial F
f^{(k)}: The k-th formal derivative of f.
a: The real coefficient of x when p is affine.
b: The real constant term when p is affine.
d: The degree of the nonzero polynomial r.
\\alpha: an arbitrary complex root of F
m: the positive integer multiplicity of alpha as a root of F
u: the complex polynomial determined by F(alpha+t)=t^m u(t)
B: the polynomial obtained after factoring t^m from F(alpha+t)+F(p(alpha+t))
A: A real polynomial in two variables occurring in the exact first-order polynomial Taylor identity for r.
k: A nonnegative integer exponent in the binomial expansion.
